answer_1.quote: Works in neural machine translation (NMT) greatly improve translation quality.

answer_2.quote: We use metrics including BLEU, ChrF, COMET and BLEURT to evaluate models performances on test sets.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation on ZhEn to verify the enhancement brought by TST BT. We randomly sample 300 sentences from WMT17-19 original and reverse test sets respectively. We follow the evaluation scheme mentioned by , and 8 professional annotators are recruited to rate adequacy and fluency of three MT results on a 5-point scale, given source text and reference.
answer_4.guideline: rate adequacy and fluency on a 5-point scale
